name: Local House Restaurant
address: Historical Neighbourhood, LOCAL HOUSE - 51 - 65 Al Fahidi St - Bur Dubai - Al Fahidi - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description:
Ever tried a camel burger? Head to the Local House, the first Dubai restaurant to popularise the Arabian delicacy as part of Emirati cuisine. Located within one of the oldest houses in Al Fahidi, the restaurant interiors closely exude the vibe of Old Dubai.

Established in 1997 by Mr. Khalid Al Halyan, the restaurant has been featured in several leading news stories. Enter a colourful verandah where Arabian hospitality thrives in every corner and staff. At the gate, you will find the oldest buckthorn tree in Dubai.

Find greens hanging down the roof, comfortable seating options and Insta-friendly backdrops. Browse the old newspaper-style menu, featuring genuine Emirati flavours including a range of seafood, starters, salads, burgers.

reviews.author: A JP DUBAI
reviews.text:
If you are looking for a truly unique and memorable dining experience in the heart of the city, Local House Restaurant is an absolute must-visit. I recently went for dinner and gave it a full five stars across the board for food, service, and atmosphere because it genuinely delivers on every front. One of the biggest highlights of this spot is the opportunity to try camel meat, which is quite rare and hard to find at most typical restaurants. Whether you are a curious traveler or a resident looking for something different, their camel dishes are incredibly delicious, tender, and perfectly seasoned. It is a culinary experience you won’t want to miss.
Beyond the adventurous menu, the pricing is remarkably affordable. It is rare to find such high-quality, authentic flavors at such a reasonable price point, especially in such a charming historic area. The portions are generous, offering great value for every guest. The atmosphere is another major draw; it has a wonderful, vibrant local vibe that makes you feel like you have stepped into a traditional part of the city's heritage. It is the perfect destination for tourists who want to enjoy authentic charm and a relaxed environment. The service was equally impressive—warm, welcoming, and very attentive. I highly recommend this place for anyone seeking a real taste of local culture and hospitality.

reviews.author: Jason Saler
reviews.text: Came here with some coworkers and had an excellent time. The staff were friendly and attentive. The food and beverages were all very delicious and getting to try camel for the first time was a unique and fun experience for me! I would recommend Local house for anyone looking to experience some traditional dishes and/or camel!

reviews.author: Paramount Ace
reviews.text: i was visit for this restraunt purpose for eating camel meat. it was well prepared with huge size of rice. meat was special feeling taste somewhere between sheep and cattle. traditional arabic style interior was good. generally overall great.

reviews.author: Alex Sergman
reviews.text:
Came here specifically to get a camel 🐪 meat.

Took camel chops (rib) - it was quite marinated, so the taste of meat itself is not obvious at all. Additionally it was just a few bites of meat of that rib - rest is bone and gristle.

Best option (which was available today - no sup) - camel meat with hummus - no seasoning in meat - so the meat taste can be tested. The portion of net is not big, but lavish amount of hummus.

Oriental salad - good portion and good salad.

Lentil soup - tasty, but ~half of portion volume is potato

Moroccan tea - is not Moroccan - it's black tea with just a few leaves of mint - doesn't with it and 100% not Moroccan style.

Asked for a jam - they brought apricot one - tastes like simple one from a supermarket.

After sunset mosquitos came on stage (we sat outside).

Additionally - chair soft seat pads packed in plastic bags - you'll be sweating if seat on them

reviews.author: NACO Dubai
reviews.text:
I visited Local House Restaurant and it was a very nice traditional dining experience.
The atmosphere is beautiful and reflects the old heritage style of Dubai.
It’s a great place to try local Emirati food.

The staff were friendly and explained the menu to us, which was very helpful for first-time visitors. I especially enjoyed the traditional camel dishes.

It’s a perfect place to take visitors who want to experience authentic local cuisine while walking around Al Seef.
I would definitely visit again. Thank you!

reviews.author: sarah jeon
reviews.text: Flavorful camel dishes! Clean and cozy atmosphere. Must try for all travelers. The camel burger didnt taste like camel meat but more on beef. I think they did it on purpose since it was a cheeseburger. They didnt put much spices to it so it would taste like the original burgers. Nonetheless, the taste of camel meat was savory and smokey. Kebab was superb!!! I hope they also served it with the yogurt sauce but everything was good! Perfect

reviews.author: Scott Boughton
reviews.text:
I love hamburgers! This Camel burger was one of the best burger I have ever had. The meat was juicy and sweet. All the flavors were amazing. Highly recommend the food.

The atmosphere was a little odd. I was the only one eating in the restaurnt but it was around 8pm. Usually that's a bad sign but I went with it and loved my meal and service. Thank you!!!

reviews.author: Alessandra Siragusa
reviews.text:
If you find yourself in the Al Fahidi district and are in the mood for something a bit different, Local House Restaurant is a must-try.
The location is pleasant and well-lit, creating a nice atmosphere. While the service can be a little slow, the food quality makes up for it.
The standout item is definitely the famous camel burger, easily the best choice on the menu.
If you stop by, I highly recommend focusing on the camel meat dishes, as they are the restaurant’s specialty.

reviews.author: Ashwin Jokhoo
reviews.text:
We visited this place on recommendations from few friends - it’s opposite to Souk Al Seef, it’s based in quite busy area where parking is at a premium. We went on a day where it wasn’t busy - the waiter took his time and explain to us the different menus of camel which was helpful.

We ordered camel biryani plus a separate fish dish - we also had a camel steak. Although some of the menus look slightly different to the photos, it was ok.

As a first timer of camel, it was ok, not mind blowing.

The restaurant has a feeling of an old building and been there for few years - some of the wall paintings and decorations looks over 20-25 years old; this gives it a rustic look.

The food is decent and the service is courteous. Overall 7/10

reviews.author: Tomas Neve
reviews.text:
I came to this place because I saw it recommended on TikTok. When I arrived, there was absolutely no one ✨ the place was completely empty. The staff was quite friendly, and I ordered the camel burger with a fresh orange juice. To my surprise, it was actually much tastier than I expected, so I do recommend it.

I personally like quieter spots, and this one definitely felt peaceful. Just keep in mind that I came at the end of August, on a Saturday afternoon, around 5:30 p.m., with the temperature at 37°C, which probably explains why it wasn’t busy.

reviews.author: FY’s SpAcE
reviews.text:
If you're looking for a unique culinary experience, this is the place to be. Not only can you try camel meat, but you can also indulge in other traditional dishes like camel biriani. And don't forget to pair your meal with some delicious Arabian coffee.
But it's not just about the food - the peaceful and welcoming atmosphere of this place makes it the perfect spot to spend some quality time.
So come on over and savor the flavors and ambiance of this amazing place.

reviews.author: MCPELaiwei
reviews.text:
TOURIST TRAP!!!!!!!!!

We went here exploring the old town, and were excited to try camel meat, however it was very dry.

To be fair, it was busy when we went, but the food still took over 45 minutes.

We ordered the camel chops, which were supposed to be like ribs, but all we were served was some ground camel patty that tasted like a dry burger. The waiter said that we would get the actual ribs if we would wait 30 minutes, but by then we wouldn’t have any time left. The waiter didn’t even apoligise and tried to avoid conversation. He said that the bones were taken out on purpose, but this still wouldn’t taste like ribs! It tastes and looks like a dry burger patty! It does not look anything like the picture on the menu of the «chops».

Please find another restaurant than this. Horrible experience here!

reviews.author: Khuram Shahzad
reviews.text:
Visited Local House Restaurant recently and was really impressed with the ambiance and the menu. The camel burger was definitely the highlight — tender, flavorful, and something you don’t find everywhere! The service was friendly and the decor gave a cozy, authentic vibe.

Only reason I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5 is because the wait time for food was a bit longer than expected, especially since it wasn’t too crowded. But overall, it’s a great spot if you’re looking to try something different and locally inspired. Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.author: Renee Cutaia
reviews.text: Came to try the camel meat. Meat has a unique flavour but not in a negative way. The camel burger was pretty juicy and flavourful and the camel biryani was also pretty good. The hummus or chilli sauce that came with the bread was super tasty! We went around 12pm and tried to get the European breakfast but they didn’t have it available so after a bit of negotiation we were able to get eggs on bread to satisfy the kids. Lots of seating inside and out. Price is a little high but camel meat isn’t cheap so it’s reasonable. Service is only so so, the lady helping us wasn’t very friendly and other tables has issues with their order & with getting service. It’s a shame service was so poor because we have had really good service while in Dubai and this was the first one to really be disappointing. If you want to try camel meat I would say this is a good option.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you . We’re grateful for your feedback. We are looking forward to serve you again. Have a wonderful day!

reviews.author: Patricia Jacquod
reviews.text: The most beautiful terrasse in the middle of the Medina. So peaceful !! The meals we ordered were amazing and very well served (special mention for RITA, very caring, kind and sweet) And very good value for money. Don’t miss it !

reviews.author: Portia Anima
reviews.text: We had a beautiful family Emirates breakfast experience at Al Fahidi, made truly memorable by the exceptional service from Aiok and Saeed. As we are new to the country and visiting on holiday, they made us feel warmly welcomed and completely at ease from the start. When it suddenly started raining, they thoughtfully accompanied us indoors so we could comfortably continue enjoying our breakfast without any disruption. Their attentiveness did not stop there — the dessert was delightful, and the house tour that followed was absolutely top-notch, adding a special cultural touch to the entire experience. The care, professionalism, and genuine hospitality we received were outstanding. We enjoyed it so much that we will definitely be visiting again. Thank you, Aiok and Saeed, for making our visit unforgettable.

reviews.author: Valeriia Koval
reviews.text:
Local House Restaurant is, without a doubt, the best place to taste authentic local cuisine. From the moment you step inside you are completely immersed in the culture — the décor, the music and the warm atmosphere make every visit feel special and true to the place. The whole setting is beautiful and instantly puts you in the mood to slow down and enjoy every bite.

The food is simply outstanding. Each dish is prepared with care and full of flavour — a true pleasure for the palate. Whether it’s a leisurely breakfast or a relaxed lunch, every meal here feels like a celebration. My family and I come every week for a special weekend breakfast or a lovely lunch, and it never disappoints.

What elevates Local House even higher is the people. The service is exceptional and genuinely kind-hearted. A huge thank you to Manager Chinni, Aloc, Mansur, Saeed and especially Chef Yemen — their attention to detail and hospitality shine through in everything. The cashier Wint was so sweet and professional, and Soraya (who is on vacation now but has always given us incredible attention on previous visits) has been wonderful too. Today we were surprised with so many thoughtful gifts and little compliments from the team — I was honestly amazed by their generosity and warmth.

This isn’t just a restaurant — it’s an experience that both tourists and locals should not miss. If you want authentic flavours, a cultural atmosphere, and service that makes you feel truly welcome, make sure to visit Local House. Five stars from my family — we already can’t wait to come back.

reviews.author: Андрій Барабаш
reviews.text:
We really wanted to try camel meat, but we deeply regret visiting this place. We ordered biryani — it was quite average, with way more spices than actual meat. We also ordered fish but changed our mind a couple of minutes later. However, they refused to cancel it, saying it was already on the grill (which we’re pretty sure wasn’t true).

On top of that, we ordered just one bottle of soda, but they added two to the bill. Even after we pointed it out, the waiter still charged us an extra 10 dirhams.

I don’t like leaving bad reviews, but this place is terrible mainly because of the dishonest service. It really feels like they’re trying to trick customers from the very beginning.

Not recommended!

reviews.author: Anupa M
reviews.text: This is a cute and cozy emirati restaurant in the picturesque al fahidi/ al seef zone of dubai, they are known to serve budge friendly local UAE cuisine and an assortment of mixed arabic dishes too. They serve camel meat dishes too. The whole restaurant looks very instaworthy and there is plenty of indoor and outdoor seating available .

reviews.author: Debbie Penner
reviews.text: My friend was visiting from Canada and I wanted her to taste camel meat, so I took her to this lovely restaurant. We have taken all our guests here over the years and we just love it . The ambiance is beautiful and peaceful. The menu is diverse, serving all kinds of meat and fish- not just camel. The staff go above and beyond. They brought us free bowl of camel soup, and when I spilled mine they quickly cleaned it up and brought me a new bowl. They kept us supplied with fresh hot Arabic  bread.  Gave us beautiful bowls of  salad. They’re were attentive but not annoying. We will continue bringing all our guests here.  Our servers, Neville and Gislan were friendly and helpful. I highly recommend this wonderful Arabic restaurant.

reviews.author: Xuan
reviews.text: The food is amazing.  I almost never order chicken  in the restaurant but I ordered the chicken here because my family already ordered camel steak and lamb.  To my surprise,  the chicken is so tasty and of course the camel steak is unbelievable tender and delicious.  Same as the lamb.  Every thing is so flavorful and it is the best Arabian meal I have ever had.  The host is very friendly and the restaurant is beautiful with local decorations.

reviews.author: João Leitão
reviews.text:
The Local House Restaurant in Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood is one of those places that grabs your attention right from the entrance. Its traditional architecture, outdoor tables, and camel statue give it a unique charm. As soon as you step inside, you're greeted by beautiful wall paintings of people in Arabic traditional clothes, urging you to snap a photo.

The place opens up after a short corridor into a spacious dining area, built inside a local house. The wooden tables, plates, cutlery, and floor tiles create a simple but attractive environment.

For my meal, I tried chicken liver, camel meat biryani, taboula salad, fresh oven-baked bread, yogurt, and chutney. The presentation was impressive—everything looked fresh and appealing, especially the bread and salad. The biryani came in a nice copper pot, adding an extra touch to the whole experience.

Now, onto the taste. The salad was well seasoned—maybe a touch too salty for some, but I found it just right. The soup complemented the meal well, and the chicken liver had an interesting taste, reminding me of shrimp or seafood. The camel meat was very tender, and the biryani was packed with ingredients like raisins. Despite the interesting mix, the overall taste was a bit subdued—not bad, but nothing mind-blowing either.

When it comes to the quality of ingredients, they certainly don't cut corners. Everything looked and tasted fresh, and you could tell they chose their ingredients carefully.

The staff were terrific. The manager was friendly and chatty, and the servers were very accommodating.

As for the price, it was reasonable—what you'd expect for a meal in this range.

All in all, Local House Restaurant is a good spot for quality, traditional food in a charming environment. While the food isn't necessarily something to rave about, it's a nice experience overall, and I wouldn't mind going back.
